mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_conversation (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, conversation_id, run_id, reserved, revision, session_format, session_hash, session_bytes, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, FALSE, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{updatedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, conversation_id, run_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM campaign_conversation_create WHERE ctid IN ( SELECT ledger.ctid FROM campaign_conversation_create ledger WHERE ledger.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ledger.program_id = #{programId} AND ledger.user_id = #{userId} AND ledger.expires_at <= #{sweepBefore, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM campaign_conversation live WHERE live.tenant_id = ledger.tenant_id AND live.program_id = ledger.program_id AND live.user_id = ledger.user_id AND live.conversation_id = ledger.conversation_id AND live.run_id = ledger.run_id) ORDER BY ledger.expires_at ASC LIMIT #{limit})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO campaign_conversation_create (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, create_key, fingerprint, conversation_id, run_id, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{userId}, #{createKey}, #{fingerprint}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, create_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO campaign_conversation_outcome (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, conversation_id, run_id, idempotency_key, fingerprint, result_hash, result_bytes, created_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{programId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{runId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{fingerprint}, #{resultHash}, #{resultBytes, jdbcType=BINARY}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, program_id, user_id, conversation_id, run_id, idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET fingerprint = EXCLUDED.fingerprint, result_hash = EXCLUDED.result_hash, result_bytes = EXCLUDED.result_bytes, created_at = EXCLUDED.created_at, expires_at = EXCLUDED.expires_at
